structured_output.summary: Ships as one PR: enum, DagModel column plus migration, scheduler changes (dags_needing_dagruns, partitioned assets, finalize step, loop timer), asset manager, auto-pause, public and UI REST, CLI, docs and newsfragment, with tests. Most in-flight scheduling needs no change because a draining Dag keeps is_paused=False; the generated OpenAPI yaml files are declared but should be regenerated by the repo tooling. airflow-ctl generated datamodels are left alone.

intents.rationale: Enum does not exist yet; add next to DagRunState.
DagModel has only is_paused; need column, constraint, index, property, setter, migration after head f8c2a1d94e03, db.py head map, migrations-ref, and Backfill index.
dags_needing_dagruns, asset manager queueing (direct, alias, name/uri) and partitioned APDR selection must skip draining Dags.

A draining Dag keeps is_paused=False, so TI scheduling, queued-run start and running-run examination queries (all filter on is_paused) already treat it as active; explicit triggers do not check the flag. Tests will pin this.
New _finalize_draining_dags method and 5s timer in the loop.
Auto-pause update sets only is_paused=True; must also set is_draining=False (and keep the audit log).
DAGPatchBody only has required is_paused; responses lack scheduling_state; routes only accept update_mask ['is_paused'] and bulk sets only is_paused.
Add scheduling_state filter, has_unfinished_runs per Dag (independent of dag_runs_limit), and dashboard active count excluding draining.
set_is_paused only touches is_paused and filters on is_paused != target; must use set_scheduling_state and match draining Dags. dags details uses DAGResponse so gets scheduling_state once added.
Docs describe only pause; add draining to concepts page and FAQ plus a newsfragment (user-facing).

evidence.quote: The Dags have several states when it comes to being "not running".

intents.rationale: Add/extend tests in existing suites; update existing tests asserting old PATCH validation and CLI behaviour.

criteria.text: DagSchedulingState has exactly members with values 'active','draining','paused'.

DagModel.scheduling_state derives from flags (paused->paused, draining->draining, else active); set_scheduling_state sets both flags consistently for each state; is_draining defaults to False; DB rejects is_paused and is_draining both true.

Alembic migration (airflow_version 3.4.0, down_revision f8c2a1d94e03) adds is_draining non-null default false with index and check constraint, plus index on backfill(dag_id, completed_at); ORM matches; db.py head map and migrations-ref.rst updated.
dags_needing_dagruns excludes draining Dags (scheduled and asset-triggered) but includes active ones.
register_asset_change records the AssetEvent but creates no queue entry for a draining Dag scheduled directly, via alias, or via name/URI reference; active Dags still queued.
_create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags creates no run for pending APDRs of a draining Dag, and does after it is active again.
For a draining Dag, queued runs are started, running runs are examined and scheduled TIs are queued by the scheduler; manual trigger of a draining Dag still creates a run.

_finalize_draining_dags pauses (is_paused true, is_draining false) a draining Dag with no queued/running run and no backfill without Dag runs, and writes Log event 'drain_completed' owner 'scheduler'.
_finalize_draining_dags leaves a Dag draining when it has a queued or running run, or a backfill row with no associated Dag runs; non-draining Dags are untouched; Dags processed in dag_id order.
The scheduler loop registers _finalize_draining_dags with a 5 second regular interval.
Auto-pause after max consecutive failed runs sets is_paused true and is_draining false for a draining Dag.
DAGResponse and DAGDetailsResponse include scheduling_state reflecting the model (default active).
PATCH /dags/{dag_id} and PATCH /dags accept scheduling_state or is_paused; both present, both null, or only field null returns 422; explicit null for unused field accepted.
update_mask ['scheduling_state'] or ['is_paused'] accepted when matching the body; a mask naming the other field than the body carries returns 422; response and DB reflect the new state.
Bulk PATCH sets both flags for every matched Dag; is_paused true pauses and false activates, both clearing draining.
/ui/dags scheduling_state filter returns only Dags in that state; paused=false still includes draining Dags.
Every Dag in /ui/dags has has_unfinished_runs true iff a queued or running run exists, even when dag_runs_limit hides it.
Dashboard active_dag_count excludes draining Dags.
'dags pause' sets paused and clears draining; 'dags unpause' sets active and clears draining; a draining Dag is matched by both commands.
'dags details' output includes scheduling_state.
core-concepts/dags.rst and faq.rst describe draining; airflow-core newsfragment announcing it exists (user-facing, written with 'Dag').

tasks.summary: Implement draining end to end. Order: add DagSchedulingState; DagModel column/constraint/property/setter, Backfill index and migration with db.py head map and migrations-ref; then scheduler/dagrun/asset manager changes; then public and UI API and parameters (regenerate OpenAPI yamls); then CLI; then docs and newsfragment; update existing tests that assert the old PATCH validation (is_paused required), CLI pause/unpause query and dag details/response field lists, then add new tests per suite. Do not touch airflow-core/src/airflow/ui.
